caption:
Balance has been on Koko's mind lately, so two poles came along on the morning walk.

Nordic walking uses two specially designed poles that you plant behind you and push back on as you stride. Arms, shoulders and trunk join in, turning a regular walk into a light full-body session, and many people say they feel steadier too.

With the pole tip beside your foot, your elbow should sit near a right angle. Start with 15 to 20 minutes on flat ground in the cool of the morning.

Joint pain that builds, a swollen knee or ankle, or chest discomfort is worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can check your technique. Book online via the link in bio
